name: GHP
comment: GHP grammar: HTML with <go .../> tags that embed real Go. Every GHP tag is self-closing (ends with '/>'). The order of the patterns in #ghp-tags matters — see the comment there.

ghp-tags.comment: Mandatory order: the most specific tags first. `go:import` before the generic `go:*` (otherwise `import` would fall into the control pattern), the block close before the control (otherwise `endif`/`endswitch`/`endfor` could match wrong), and all before plain `go=`/`go`.

self-closing.comment: The '/' that closes the tag — isolated in its own pattern with a lookahead for '>', so the source.go grammar does not consume it as a division operator (which would break the '(>)' end of tags with Go content).
self-closing.name: punctuation.definition.tag.end.ghp

tag-block-close.comment: <go:endif/>, <go:endswitch/>, <go:endfor/> — closing of the block tags with a body.
tag-block-close.name: meta.tag.close.ghp

tag-control.comment: Control structures. `else` and `default` take no expression; `if`, `elif`, `switch`, `case`, and `for` take real Go up to the `/>`.
tag-control.name: meta.tag.control.ghp

tag-echo.comment: <go= expression/> — renders the expression's value, with automatic escaping.
tag-echo.name: meta.tag.echo.ghp

tag-statement.comment: <go .../> — block of Go code (statement), possibly multi-line. The lookahead prevents matching `go:`, `go=`, or identifiers that just start with `go` (e.g.: a `<google>` literal in HTML).
tag-statement.name: meta.tag.statement.ghp
